preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The values of M and N are between 0 and 10^6, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: The length of the string does not exceed 10^6 characters.
preconditions.description: The length of the string in each test case does not exceed 10^6 characters.

preconditions.expression: The string consists only of characters 'R' and 'K'.
preconditions.description: Each character in the string is either 'R' or 'K'.

postconditions.expression: The output contains two space-separated integers for each test case.
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output should include the number of substrings containing exactly M 'R' characters and the number of substrings containing exactly N 'K' characters.
